transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Hi Ruth. Tell me a little about what's going on.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: My husband died in March. Forty-one years. Since then I can't settle - there's a knot in my chest from the moment I wake up.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: I'm so sorry. Are you sleeping?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Three or four hours. I wake at two and that's that.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: No. I want to feel better, not disappear.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Any heart conditions or blood pressure problems?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Blood pressure was fine at my physical in May.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Ruth, hi, I'm Kara. Your anxiety score is 17, depression 16. Given what you've been through, that makes sense, and I do think this could help you.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: There's one snag. The identification on your account doesn't match the name you've given me - I think you may have signed up under a maiden name or a shortened name.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Oh - the account might be in my husband's name. He set up all our online things.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: That would explain it. I can't write a prescription until I've verified who I'm prescribing for. If you can send us a photo of a government ID, I'll approve it the same day.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I'll ask my daughter to help me with that.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: [note to file] Clinically appropriate, approving on receipt of ID. Recently bereaved, low technical confidence, mentioned her daughter handles her computer. If the ID doesn't arrive within a few days someone should call her rather than keep texting a link.

notes.clinical_summary: 68F, bereavement-related anxiety and insomnia following spousal death March 2026. GAD 17 / PHQ 16. No SI. No cardiac history. Clinically appropriate for treatment.
notes.plan: HOLD pending government photo ID - account identity does not match patient. Approve and prescribe on receipt. Patient has limited technical confidence; telephone follow-up preferred if ID not received promptly.
